title: Smart Micro-Apartment Energy Layout Planner
description: Users design a compact micro-apartment by positioning a commercial refrigerator within a minimalistic modern bedroom, balancing spatial comfort, energy efficiency, and thermal zoning. The planner enforces a fixed energy budget: adding cooling power to the refrigerator reduces available heating for the bedroom, and vice versa. Users must iteratively adjust placement, orientation, energy allocation, and wall insulation across multiple coupled steps with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader from CDN. Load 'shared_assets/minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb' as the room shell and 'shared_assets/CommercialRefrigerator.glb' as a placeable appliance. Set up a perspective camera at a 3/4 overhead angle with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (0.4) and a warm directional light simulating a window. Implement these interactions: (1) Drag-and-drop the refrigerator to snap positions on a 6x6 grid overlaid on the bedroom floor. (2) Rotate the refrigerator in 90-degree increments via R key. (3) An energy budget slider (total 100 units) that couples refrigerator cooling power and bedroom heating — increasing one decreases the other automatically (conservation law). (4) A wall insulation toggle for each of the 4 bedroom walls (on/off), where enabling insulation costs 5 energy units deducted from the total budget, dynamically reducing both sliders proportionally. (5) A thermal comfort score displayed as a HUD overlay, computed from refrigerator distance to the bed center, energy allocation ratio, insulation count, and refrigerator orientation relative to walls. (6) Full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) tracking all state changes: position, rotation, energy split, and insulation toggles. (7) A 'Validate' button that checks if the score exceeds a threshold and highlights conflicts (refrigerator too close to bed, insufficient heating, etc.) with red outlines. Use a right-side HTML panel for sliders, insulation checkboxes, score display, and undo/redo buttons. Color-code the floor grid: blue for cool zones near the fridge, orange for warm zones near heating, intensity driven by energy allocation. Minimum 10 steps to reach an optimal layout. Render at 60fps with antialiasing enabled.
